content_fields.title: Prevent SQL injection with ORM queries and parameterized raw SQL (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Perform the update through the ORM, or bind every parameter if raw SQL is unavoidable.
content_fields.finding: Raw SQL is assembled with f-string interpolation instead of bound parameters or the ORM.
content_fields.current_code:
raw_sql = f"""
        UPDATE orders 
        SET status = '{status_value}'
        WHERE id = {order_id}
    """
    db.execute(text(raw_sql))
    db.commit()
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/apis/orders/services/get_order_status.py
db_order.status = OrderStatus(delivery_data["status"])
db.add(db_order)
db.commit()

# Parameterized equivalent if raw SQL is required:
# db.execute(
#     text("UPDATE orders SET status = :status WHERE id = :order_id AND user_id = :user_id"),
#     {"status": db_order.status.value, "order_id": order_id, "user_id": current_user.id},
# )
criteria: No f-string or concatenation appears inside a text() call.
External values are validated against the enum before they reach the database.
The update is additionally scoped to the owning user.
